styleLock.direction: street-editorial kidswear commerce built as poster pages: cream rounded panels, deep ink frames and flat amber geometric blocks around clean studio garment shots
styleLock.backgroundSystem: poster-like stage set: one warm cream rounded poster field #F4EDE0 as the recurring light ground, deep ink charcoal #232329 as frame and dark ground, soft studio grey #D8DDE2 for seamless model shots, one sun-warmed outdoor court pavement variant for the single scene frame; flat amber blocks #F2B705 only ever enter as rectangular layout devices, never as full scenery
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key with broad bounce fill, one soft contact shadow under every hem, neutral 5200K on the scene frame; a narrow skimming light band is allowed only on the neckline macro; no harsh speculars, no coloured gels
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless studio sweep #D8DDE2 for worn frames, matte cream poster board #F4EDE0 for flat lays and trust screens, matte ink panel #232329 for dark screens; no wood grain, no marble, no turf, no rattan
styleLock.typography: bold geometric sans-serif display capitals used only as graphic bands that never carry a fact, plus one clean humanist sans for every Chinese label; headline 28-46pt, label 11-14pt, per-screen copy budget under 50 characters; in-image Chinese appears only as bracketed selling-point or callout placeholders inside a declared copy zone
styleLock.iconSystem: flat solid geometric layout devices only: dot-grid rows of small ink dots, thin ink frames, rectangular amber blocks and empty square outline cells; no circular badge, no ribbon, no laurel, no certificate border
styleLock.presentationRules: the sleeveless vest, inner tee and shorts always read as one set at one locked scale, hero scale never shifting more than five percent between screens; the rectangular chest print position is named structurally and never redrawn; every worn frame uses a generic child body cropped below the neck or seen from behind, never an identifiable face
noDrift: no palette drift beyond cream #F4EDE0, ink #232329, amber #F2B705 and grey #D8DDE2
no mixed fonts, no script or serif display
no random backgrounds, no furnished interiors replacing the poster-studio system
no inconsistent lighting direction between screens
no identifiable child face, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent street-editorial children's apparel system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm cream poster field #F4EDE0, deep ink charcoal #232329, one amber block accent #F2B705 and soft studio grey #D8DDE2; bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left key, broad bounce fill and one soft contact shadow, 5200K on the scene frame; bold geometric sans-serif display capitals paired with one clean humanist sans for labels; flat solid geometric layout devices only, dot-grid rows, thin ink frames and rectangular amber blocks, never circular badges or ribbons; the sleeveless vest, inner tee and shorts always read as one set at one locked scale; in-image Chinese appears only as bracketed selling-point or callout placeholders inside a declared copy zone; every worn body is a generic child cropped below the neck or seen from behind; no palette drift, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no invented certification.

provenance.notes: 源为同一套装的十一屏详情切片，逐屏事实：一、封面为深墨底上一块奶油圆角海报板，模特穿黑色无袖圆领卫衣背心叠白色长袖内搭与黑色短裤，带英文字标标题、红色促销横条与上线日期字样；二、四联站姿展示（抱臂、垂手、正面全身、半身特写）置于浅灰棚拍背景，标题为潮流卫衣与套装字样；三、中英抒情填充文案两段加一张正面站姿大图与竖排装饰字；四、下半身与球鞋特写接深墨商品信息板：品牌名、货号、颜色、尺码一栏，三条属性滑轨（厚度、弹性、柔软），五枚洗护小方格（其中一枚含具体水温数字字样），下方为以身高码定档的尺码表（列：衣长、胸围、腰围、下摆、肩宽、袖长）；五、尺码表续行后接细节展示页：左侧全身照加右侧墨黑圆领特写圆窗与两行文案；六、两格细节瓷砖（袖口罗纹字样、肩部压线字样）中间夹素材站水印与二维码，接模特展示标题与黄黑几何色块；七至十、全部为黄黑几何版式色块与外文栏目字样，无商品信息；十一、墨黑底白色卡片写黄色色系字样，左下角会员招募角标与二维码。品类判定依据：尺码表以一百二至一百六号段身高码定档，衣长与胸围量级明显落在中大童区间，属儿童身高码体系而非成人服装尺码，故判母婴／童装而非男装；商品信息板另写一栏跨度更大的尺码范围且成品画面为成人模特以宽松穿法展示，两处体系互相矛盾，因此任何尺码、身高与尺寸数字都不作为事实写入，尺码格一律留空；画面为无袖圆领卫衣背心加短裤的外穿运动套装，非贴身内衣亦非家居睡衣，故不入内衣家居服／儿童内衣。已剥离内容：原品牌名与货号字样、素材站水印与全部二维码、会员招募角标、红色促销横条与上线日期、英文标题字与中英抒情填充文案、竖排装饰字、属性滑轨档位词、含具体水温数字的洗护字样、尺码表全部数值、模特面容发型与身份、色名与色号字样；胸前矩形印花只保留矩形图位这一结构描述，图案交给 product_identity_lock 承接。与近似模版差异（对照同段 suite-muying-nvtong-shuini-tiequ-weiyi-taozhuang 逐条）：一、背景体系上，本套为棚拍海报编辑风——奶油圆角海报板、墨黑相框边栏、雾灰无缝棚地加一帧户外球场地面，不用其风化水泥旧墙与锈蚀钢窗棂真实外壳；二、色板上，本套锁定奶油米白、墨黑、琥珀黄与雾灰四色，强调色为矩形琥珀几何块，不使用其水泥灰、石灰浆白与氧化铁红体系，也避开同段高频的糖果粉、天蓝与柠檬黄体系；三、道具上，本套只用点阵行、细线墨框、空白尺码格、空白色卡方格与一颗篮球，不用其钢制踏步凳、开盘录音机与卡纸阵列；四、机位体系上，本套八桶为正面平视、四分之三近裁、拼版对照、膝高随拍、正侧九十度微距、九十度俯视平铺、正背双板与四十五度俯视，含两处俯视与一处膝高仰观起手，与其以仰观起手加侧身微距的中段结构排布不同；五、角色序列上，本套九镜以促销几何收口收尾且含痛点镜，与其七镜信任收口且无痛点镜的序列不同；六、版式元件上，本套用圆角海报板、点阵行与矩形琥珀色块加空按钮位，不用其切角卡、三轨滑条与方印框阵列。另查男装段近似件（宽松套头卫衣、黑白灰圆领印花T恤）属男装／上衣，与本套童装套装品类不同，体系无重叠。同段三种色温取值已被大量占用，本套差异主要落在色板构成、背景外壳、道具、机位、角色序列与版式元件六个层面。
